definitions.gloss: to scrape, to graze, to skin
definitions.explanation: To scrape skin off by friction, typically from falling down. A very common childhood experience.

examples.japanese: {転|ころ}んで{肘|ひじ}をすりむいた。
examples.english: I fell and scraped my elbow.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}が{遊|あそ}んでいて{手|て}をすりむいてしまった。
examples.english: The child scraped their hand while playing.

notes:
KANJI: Can be written as {擦|す}り{剥|む}く.

TRANSITIVITY: Transitive. Takes the body part as the direct object with を.

WORD FORMATION: {擦|す}る (to rub) + {剥|む}く (to peel).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {膝|ひざ}をすりむく (to scrape one's knee)
- {肘|ひじ}をすりむく (to scrape one's elbow)
- {手|て}をすりむく (to scrape one's hand)

RELATED: すり{傷|きず} (scrape, graze - the resulting wound).
